g.text: 2021–2022 training period | 5,840 arrivals | 500 m AGL arrival height
Passage is intersection with geographic polygons along adjacent hourly modeled path segments; age 0 is excluded.
A path can visit multiple regions. Percentages do not sum to 100%. Boundaries may count in both adjacent regions.
Sea / unclassified includes mixed-source coastline gaps; it is not guaranteed actual sea.
These are modeled air-path passage rates, not pollution mass, source contributions, or station data availability.
